in_sanskrit.name: Mayukhi
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of Beauty
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mayukhi एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Mayukhi is the name of the goddess of beauty and prosperity in Hindu mythology. Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘mai’, meaning ‘mother’, and ‘yuk’ meaning ‘beauty’, this name symbolizes the grace and charm of a mother. It is also believed that invoking the blessings of Mayukhi bestows upon one the gifts of beauty, longevity, and prosperity.
